opening.argument: The presentation promotes participation in a OneCoin company by linking a minimum investment with claimed profits and future price growth. It says early members will profit “with a minimum investment, because the price will increase over time,” while also offering tokens that can be used to buy mining space and asserting that members can “mine it and get their profits.” The material further presents token trading or mining opportunities, previews a compensation plan, and invokes claimed legal certification to support participation. These are prospective promotional claims tied to paid mining or node returns; the material does not establish actual returns or completed purchases.
